Hi @eng-18, regarding TEXTKIT-101 and tokenize_words edge cases: In the design review, we agreed that apostrophes inside words are kept. An apostrophe (ASCII ' or U+2019) directly between two letters stays part of the token, and U+2019 is normalized to ASCII "'". So "Don't" -> "don't" and "it's" -> "it's". Apostrophes elsewhere (like quotes 'this' or plural possessives "users'") act as separators.
